title: A Sharp KL-Convergence Analysis for Diffusion Models under Minimal Assumptions
tldr_zh: 「PF-ODE 双步+前向加噪单步」把 KL 迭代复杂度从 Õ(d/ε²) 提到 Õ(d log^{3/2}(1/δ)/ε)，仅需 L² score 与二阶矩（预印本）
tldr_en: Preprint: an ODE-step-plus-forward-noising scheme achieves ε²-KL in Õ(d log^{3/2}(1/δ)/ε) steps under L2-accurate scores and finite second moment, improving Õ(d/ε²).
key_numbers: Iteration complexity K = Θ(d log^{3/2}(1/δ)/ε_score) for Õ(ε_score²) KL (Cor. 3.2)
Previous best K = Θ(d log²(1/δ)/ε_score²) (Benton et al. 2023)
ODE discretization error ≤ ½(h_k+h_{k-1})³ ∫ e^{4t} E||s_r'||² dt (Lemma A.4)
